entities.title: No web build, no phones or touch
entities.impact: The game cannot be played in a browser like the repository's other games, nor on a phone.

entities.title: No autosave and no saving in flight
entities.summary: The pilot saves only while docked, by hand.
entities.impact: Everything since the last save is lost on death or on quitting.

entities.title: No content the rules lack
entities.summary: No missions, extra ship types, other lasers or difficulty modes.
entities.impact: The game is the 1984 game's systems and no more; ideas that change rules are open questions for play-testing.
